content.text:
The soft delete for comments is built, but I could not run the tests or `prisma migrate deploy` in this session, so both are unverified.

**Answers to the two questions**

1. Deleting a comment sets `deletedAt` and keeps the row. Comments with `deletedAt` set are left out of comment lists. Only the comment's author may delete it. (`policy-soft-delete.md`)
2. New error responses use `{"error":{"code":"<machine_code>","message":"<text>"}}`. Status codes do not change. For this delete, a missing comment or one owned by someone else returns 404. A missing or bad token still returns 401 from the existing auth handler, which I did not change. (`policy-error-response.md`, `code-comment-ownership.md`, `code-error-shape.md`)

**Source conflict:** `ops-runbook.md` says new error responses should follow the errors-by-field shape, which is the older body that `policy-error-response.md` says it replaces. I followed the policy. Support staff who read the `errors` key will not see these new delete errors, so the runbook needs updating.

**What changed (all under `app/`)**
- `src/prisma/schema.prisma`: added `deletedAt DateTime?` to `Comment`, after the `editedAt` line that feature 1 already had.
- `src/prisma/migrations/20261030130000_comment_soft_delete/migration.sql`: adds the nullable column, with an undo line.
- `src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts`:
  - `deleteComment` looks up by id, author and `deletedAt: null`, then sets `deletedAt` with an update instead of deleting the row.
  - `getCommentsByArticle` adds `deletedAt: null` to the comment filter.
- `src/tests/services/article.service.soft-delete.test.ts`: new unit tests for the delete and list behaviour.

I did not touch the feature 1 and feature 2 changes already in the working tree.

**Rules applied**

| Rule | Value applied | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Delete behaviour | Set `deletedAt` and keep the row | `policy-soft-delete.md` |
| List behaviour | Exclude comments with `deletedAt` set | `policy-soft-delete.md` |
| Who may delete | Only the author | `policy-soft-delete.md` |
| Error body shape | `{"error":{"code","message"}}` | `policy-error-response.md` (conflicts with `ops-runbook.md`, see above) |
| Status codes | Unchanged. Delete returns 404 when not found or not the author | `policy-error-response.md`, `code-comment-ownership.md` |
| Author identity | User id from the token, via the existing `auth.required` | `code-auth-header.md` |
| Comment fields | Added nullable `deletedAt`, no other field changes | `code-comment-model.md`, spec |
| Migration location and deploy | `app/src/prisma/migrations/<timestamp>_name`, `npx prisma migrate deploy`, `DATABASE_URL` | `code-migrations.md` |
| Fresh-database check and undo note | Undo line included. Fresh-database run not done (no database here) | `policy-release-checklist.md` |
| Test location and run | `app/src/tests/services/*.test.ts`, `npx nx test api`, mock in `prisma-mock.ts` | `code-test-layout.md` |

**Choices the notes did not settle (please confirm)**
- **Error code and message text:** the notes give the shape but no list of machine codes. I used `comment_not_found` and `comment not found`. These are my values, not rules.
- **Deleting an already-deleted comment:** the lookup filters out deleted rows, so the second delete returns 404.
- **Non-author delete:** returns 404, following the lookup-by-author behaviour in the notes. The 403 branch after the lookup is unreachable and I left it as it was.
- **`updatedAt`:** not changed by delete, since the spec does not ask for it.
- **Rollback:** the undo line drops the column, so any stored deletion times are lost.
